entries.summary: Acts first after tying the dinosaurs on initiative 8. Hits the nearer dinosaur with his staff (17 to hit) and spends ki on Frightening Strike; it is frightened until the beginning of his next turn. Hits the other dinosaur with his second staff attack (20 to hit) for 12 damage and frightens it as well. Uses Flurry of Blows for two unarmed strikes, one against each dinosaur; the last strike is confirmed to hit and the first dinosaur is described as badly wounded. The first staff attack and unarmed damage totals are not spoken.
entries.note: The first Flurry of Blows target is implied by the following question about the first dinosaur; only the second unarmed target is explicit.

entries.summary: Both frightened, wounded dinosaurs abandon their meal and run into the jungle.
Declines the offered opportunity attack as the dinosaurs flee; no additional attack is made.

ending.summary: Both dinosaurs escape into the jungle. Elazar survives, wounded but able to prop himself up and speak.
